# AI SEO Deck

> AI SEO Deck is a Webflow app by Silit Labs. Keyword by keyword, it checks whether ChatGPT, Google AI Overviews, Google AI Mode, Gemini, Claude and Grok name and cite a business, and it helps improve the Webflow pages where they do not.

Each keyword is asked as two questions a customer would ask on ChatGPT, Gemini, Claude and Grok (with web search on), and as the search itself on Google AI Overviews and AI Mode: 10 answers a check for each keyword. Paid plans check every week; the free plan checks once a month on three engines. The deck shows yes, sometimes or no for each engine, the rivals named instead, the websites cited and the searches the engines ran.

Site health reads the pages of the connected site through the Webflow API, when the user asks, and lists what to fix: titles, descriptions, Open Graph values, headings, thin text and image alt text. AI SEO Deck does not crawl the published website.

Suggested titles, descriptions and answers are written by AI from the site's own pages. They reach Webflow only when the user presses Apply: a title and description as an unpublished change to the page, answers and page drafts as draft items in a CMS collection. AI SEO Deck never publishes a site. A panel in the Webflow Designer shows the keyword and the fixes of the page that is open.

## Plans (prices in US dollars)

- Free, USD 0: 3 keywords on 1 site, checked once a month on ChatGPT, Google AI Overviews and Gemini; Site health for 20 pages; suggestions to copy
- Solo, USD 19 a month or USD 190 a year: 10 keywords on 1 site, all six engines every week, Apply to Webflow, 10 keyword checks on demand a month, Site health for 100 pages
- Studio, USD 49 a month or USD 490 a year: 30 keywords across 5 sites, 30 keyword checks on demand a month, your agency name on client report links, Site health for 150 pages
- Agency, USD 149 a month or USD 1,490 a year: 100 keywords across 20 sites, 100 keyword checks on demand a month, Site health for 250 pages
- Every paid plan starts with a 7-day free trial, once per customer. The plan's price is charged on day 8 unless the plan is cancelled before.
